user_query: I'm organizing a poetry recitation event for my family and friends. Can you help me find all the poems written by a particular poet in Poetry DB? Additionally, it would be great if I could explore poems with a specific title to create a diverse program.

TaskList.description: Query the Poetry Database for all poems written by the specified poet.
Query the Poetry Database for poems that match the specified title.
Compile the results from the two queries into a scheduled program for the event.
